Effective today at 6 p.m., evacuation orders for San Clemente and San Juan Capistrano will be lifted. Via La Mirada will remain closed north of Esperanza to vehicle traffic to allow emergency crews to continue working. The burn scar remains an active fire hazard area and is closed until further notice. The fire is currently at 25% containment.
